name: 84025 · Farmington, UT
findings: ZIP 84025 (Farmington) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84025 (Farmington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84025 (Farmington) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
